newsitem.title: USA: Disney's ABC names Preston Padden president.
newsitem.headline: Disney's ABC names Preston Padden president.

text.p: Walt Disney Co's ABC Television Network said Wednesday it appointed Preston Padden president, replacing David Westin.
The appointment of Padden, a veteran TV broadcast executive, is effective this week, ABC said.
Padden was most recently chairman and chief executive officer of American Sky Broadcasting, a satellite television joint venture between News Corp and MCI Communications Corp.
Westin is now president of ABC News.
ABC said that in his position, Padden will be responsible for network sales, affiliate realtions, broadcast operations and engineering and network communications.

Before joining American Sky Broadcasting in April 1996, Padden was president for telecommunications and television for News Corp, whose unit, Fox Broadcasting Co, he joined in January 1990 as senior vice president for affiliates.
Before joining Fox, he was for four years president of the Association of Independent Television Stations Inc, the industry group for non-network stations.
He was for 12 years before that assistant general counsel of what used to be Metromedia Inc, a radio and television station operator.
